description: Infers the province from the 2-digit PREFIX of an Italian CAP (postal code); it does NOT validate the CAP itself: `valid: true` only means 5 digits with a known prefix, not that the CAP exists (we have no list of issued CAPs). If the prefix belongs to a single province it is named in `provincia_prefisso`; if it is shared by several provinces (e.g. 23 = Sondrio or Lecco, 20 = Milano or Monza-Brianza) `provincia_prefisso` is null, `stato_provincia` is "incerta" (uncertain) and `province_possibili` lists the candidates. It does NOT return the municipality (`comune` is always null: we have no CAP→municipality table). Free (€0), deterministic, no login required.
name: lookup_cap
title: Look up CAP
